## Usage

These templates support the governance framework by providing:

- Standardized input/output formats for review boards
- Consistent documentation of decisions and recommendations
- Clear accountability and follow-up tracking
- Alignment with governance policies and processes

For more information, see the [Governance Framework](../../../../governance/framework/) documentation.
